finding: The proposal page describes review as an attack. The phrase “attacks an open proposal” leaves a newcomer to infer how the review differs from advice on a draft. Fix: Say that the reviewer challenges the design and checks whether the proposal is ready for planning.
why_this_severity: The sentence still names the reviewer and lists the checks (no to fails_purpose). The verb obscures the purpose of the review and makes the reader infer what the reviewer does.
